decision.explanation: The Victoria Cup is described in D1S1 as being associated with ice hockey, specifically featuring an NHL team against a team from one of the top four European ice hockey leagues. This directly supports the association with ice hockey. The claim in D2S1 linking the Victoria Cup to cricket is unsupported and inconsistent with the detailed description of the trophy and its intended use in D1S4, which includes hockey sticks and references to ice hockey leagues.
